title: Bira – Bira’ah – Birai
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Sukkah 27a: “Rabbi Bira said that Rabbi Ami said”; there at 34b: “Bira’ah said that Rabbi Ami said.” In Bereshit Rabbah 47:5: Rabbi Abba bar Kahana in the name of Rabbi Birai; likewise he is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Sotah, chapter 3. There is also Rabbi Yehoshua son of Rabbi Birai: Midrash Shmuel 13:6. In Terumot 10:6: “Rabbi Zeira, Ada bar Gershon, Rabbi Birai”; in Pesachim, end of chapter 2: “One of those of Rabbi Birai had,” etc.

notes.text: The supplied Rabbi Bira is retained. Saved Davidson Sukkah 27a writes Bira without that title. The several spellings and father/son reference remain distinct rather than globally harmonized.
